name: SwipeCards
description: Tinder-style stack of cards: drag the top card past a threshold (or flick it) and it flies off with rotation and fade, then cycles to the back of the deck; also operable with arrow keys and prev/next buttons.
a11yNotes: The stack is a focusable role="group" that swipes the top card with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, visible Swipe left/right buttons offer a pointer-free alternative, and a polite live region announces the current card. Cards beneath the top are aria-hidden, keys stay stable with duplicate items, and prefers-reduced-motion cycles cards without the fly-out animation.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Card labels; the last item starts on top. Duplicates are supported.

propsApi.name: threshold
propsApi.description: Horizontal drag distance in pixels that commits a swipe.

propsApi.name: showControls
propsApi.description: Show the previous/next buttons below the stack.

propsApi.name: onSwipe
propsApi.description: Called after a card is swiped away.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Extra class merged onto the root.
